description: A reactivation of latent varicella-zoster virus in a sensory nerve and its skin distribution.

appearance.general: Painful grouped vesicles on an erythematous base, typically confined to one side of the body in a dermatomal distribution.

warning_signs: Facial or eye involvement, widespread lesions, severe pain, neurological symptoms, or immunosuppression requires prompt medical evaluation.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss onset time because early assessment can affect treatment options.
Mention eye, ear, or facial involvement.
